whenToUse: You mark the end of a scroll area that looks like a mobile app.
Scrolling inside a modal or panel shouldn't leak to the page.
Used together with pull to refresh.
whenNotToUse: iOS default scrolling, where the browser already bounces.
People who turned on reduced motion.

alternatives.name: Pull to Refresh
alternatives.reason: Pulling at the end to load new content.

accessibility: The scroll area has a tabIndex and a name, so it can be scrolled with the keyboard.
The stretch is decorative and isn't used to convey information.
The bounce animation turns off with reduced motion.
